vertex_projection_rays.sampling_dependency: current public editable source IDs only
vertex_projection_rays.visibility_test: nearest independent ray intersection equals the current source point within 1e-8 m

algorithm: Independent full-mesh Moller-Trumbore ray/triangle intersections, orthographic ray origins reconstructed at the camera plane from the 2x3 projection affine.
ray_direction: Exact nullspace cross product of the two supplied affine rows, oriented toward the camera forward direction.
camera_axis_alignment_tolerance: 16 * float32 epsilon in unit-vector norm, with raw affine(camera_back_axis) and measured difference retained
recovery_reason: The separately exported Blender projection affine and camera basis differ at float32 precision. Following the affine nullspace gives exact pixel-center rays for the supplied projection.
